translations.literal: Treatise on Rites, Part One
translations.idiomatic: Treatises on Rites, Part One

translations.idiomatic: Editorial bracket opens.

sentences.zh: 梁開平元年夏四月，太祖初受禪，乃立四廟於西京，從近古之制也。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the first year of Kaiping of Liang, when the Founder first received the abdication, he then established four ancestral temples in the Western Capital, following the institutions of recent antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the first year of Kaiping (907), when Liang Taizu first accepted the abdication, he established four ancestral temples in the Western Capital, in keeping with recent ancient practice.

sentences.zh: 唐同光二年六月，太常禮院奏：「國家興建之初，已於北都置廟，今克復天下，遷都洛陽，卻復本朝宗廟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Tongguang of Tang, the Directorate of Rites of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized: "At the beginning of the state's founding, temples were already established in the Northern Capital; now that the realm has been recovered, the capital is moved to Luoyang, and the ancestral temples of our dynasty are restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Tongguang (924), the Directorate of Rites of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "When the state was first founded, temples were already set up in the Northern Capital. Now that the empire has been recovered and the capital moved to Luoyang, the dynasty's ancestral temples have been restored there as well.

sentences.zh: 按禮無二廟之文，其北都宗廟請廢。

translations.literal: According to the rites, there is no text permitting two sets of ancestral temples; the ancestral temples of the Northern Capital are requested to be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: According to ritual precedent, there is no authority for maintaining two ancestral temple complexes; we request that the temples in the Northern Capital be abolished.

sentences.zh: 」乃下尚書省集議。

translations.literal: " An order was then issued to the Department of State Affairs to convene collective deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " The matter was referred to the Department of State Affairs for collective deliberation.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書王正言等奏議曰：「伏以都邑之制，宗廟為先。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Wang Zhengyan and others submitted a deliberative memorial, saying: "We humbly consider that in the institution of the capital, the ancestral temples come first.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Wang Zhengyan and others submitted their opinion: "We respectfully observe that in the organization of a capital, the ancestral temples take precedence.

sentences.zh: 今卜洛居尊，開基禦宇，事當師古，神必依人。

translations.literal: Now that Luoyang has been chosen as the seat of honor and the foundation laid to rule the realm, affairs should take antiquity as teacher, and the spirits will surely rely upon the people.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Luoyang has been chosen as the seat of power and the foundation laid to rule the realm, precedent should be followed, and the spirits will surely dwell where the people dwell.

sentences.zh: 北都先置宗廟，不宜並設。

translations.literal: The ancestral temples first established in the Northern Capital should not be maintained in parallel.
translations.idiomatic: The temples previously established in the Northern Capital ought not to be maintained alongside those in the new capital.

sentences.zh: 況每年朝享，禮有常規，時日既同，神何所據。

translations.literal: Moreover, the annual court sacrifices follow fixed ritual regulations; if the times and days are the same, upon what would the spirits rely?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the annual court sacrifices follow fixed ritual schedules; if the dates are identical, which temple would the spirits attend?

sentences.zh: 竊聞近例，亦有從權。

translations.literal: We have heard that in recent precedents there are also cases of exercising discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: We understand that recent precedents also allow for expedient measures.

sentences.zh: 如神主已修，迎之藏於夾室；

translations.literal: If the spirit tablets have already been prepared, they may be welcomed and stored in the side chambers;
translations.idiomatic: If the spirit tablets have already been prepared, they may be brought in and stored in the side chambers;

sentences.zh: 若廟宇已崇，虛之以為恒制。

translations.literal: if the temple buildings have already been erected in grandeur, they may be left vacant as a permanent institution.
translations.idiomatic: if the temple buildings have already been erected on a grand scale, they may be left standing but unused as a permanent arrangement.

sentences.zh: 若齊桓公之廟二主，禮無明文，古者師行，亦無遷於廟主。

translations.literal: As for Duke Huan of Qi's temple with two spirit-lords, the rites contain no explicit text; in antiquity when armies marched, there was also no moving of the temple spirit-lords.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Huan of Qi's temple with two spirit-lords has no explicit textual authority in the classics; in antiquity, when armies marched, the temple tablets were not moved either.

sentences.zh: 昔天後之崇鞏、洛，禮謂非宜；

translations.literal: Formerly when the Empress Wu honored both Gong and Luoyang, the rites deemed it improper;
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Wu honored both Gong and Luoyang with temples, ritualists judged it improper;

sentences.zh: 漢皇之戀豐、滕，事無所法。

translations.literal: when Emperor Han's attachment to Feng and Teng had no precedent to follow.
translations.idiomatic: and when Emperor Gaozu of Han cherished both Feng and Teng, there was no precedent to follow.

sentences.zh: 況本朝故事，禮院具明，洛邑舊都，嵩高正位，豈宜遠宮闕之居，建祖宗之廟。

translations.literal: Moreover, the precedents of our dynasty are fully clarified by the Directorate of Rites; Luoyang is the old capital and Mount Song stands in its proper position—how could one build the temples of the ancestors far from where the palace dwells?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, our own dynasty's precedents are fully documented by the Directorate of Rites. Luoyang is the ancient capital and Mount Song stands in its proper place—how could one build the ancestral temples far from the palace residence?

sentences.zh: 事非可久，理在從長。

translations.literal: The matter cannot endure long; reason lies in following what is lasting.
translations.idiomatic: Such an arrangement cannot endure; reason favors the lasting solution.

sentences.zh: 其北都宗廟，請準太常禮院申奏停廢。

translations.literal: As for the ancestral temples of the Northern Capital, we request that they be abolished in accordance with the memorial submitted by the Directorate of Rites of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: We request that the ancestral temples of the Northern Capital be abolished as proposed in the memorial from the Directorate of Rites.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 天成二年，中書門下又上奏：「伏以兩漢以諸侯王入繼帝統，則必易名上謚，廣孝稱皇，載於諸王故事，孝德皇、孝仁皇、孝元皇是也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiancheng, the Secretariat again submitted a memorial: "We humbly consider that in both Han dynasties, when a feudal prince succeeded to the imperial line, he would necessarily change the name and bestow a posthumous title, extending filial piety by styling them Huang; this is recorded in the precedents concerning princes—Emperor Xiaode, Emperor Xiaoren, and Emperor Xiaoyuan are examples.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tiancheng (927), the Secretariat again memorialized the throne: "We respectfully observe that in both Han dynasties, when a feudal prince succeeded to the imperial line, his forebears were invariably given new names and posthumous titles, extending filial devotion by styling them Huang ('Imperial'). This is recorded in the precedents on princely succession—Emperor Xiaode, Emperor Xiaoren, and Emperor Xiaoyuan are examples.

sentences.zh: 伏乞聖慈，俯從人願，許取皇而薦號，兼上謚以尊名，改置圓陵，仍增兵衛。

translations.literal: We humbly beg Your Sacred Compassion to condescend to the people's wish, permitting the adoption of Huang in presenting titles, together with bestowing posthumous titles to honor their names, relocating their tombs to round mounds, and additionally increasing military guards.
translations.idiomatic: We humbly beg Your Majesty, in condescension to the people's wishes, to permit the use of Huang in presenting titles, together with posthumous titles to honor their names, to relocate their tombs to imperial round mounds, and to increase the military guard.

sentences.zh: 」遂詔太常禮院定其儀制焉。

translations.literal: " An edict was then issued ordering the Directorate of Rites of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to fix the ritual regulations.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict was then issued directing the Directorate of Rites to establish the ceremonial regulations.

sentences.zh: 太常博士王丕等引漢桓帝入嗣，尊其祖河間孝王曰孝穆皇帝、父蠡吾侯曰孝崇皇帝為例，請付太常卿定謚。

translations.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices Academician Wang Pi and others cited Emperor Huan of Han's succession, honoring his grandfather Prince Xiao of Hejian as Emperor Xiaomu and his father Marquis Liwu as Emperor Xiaochong as precedent, and requested that the matter be referred to the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to fix the posthumous titles.
translations.idiomatic: Academician Wang Pi of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and others cited the precedent of Emperor Huan of Han's succession, in which his grandfather Prince Xiao of Hejian was honored as Emperor Xiaomu and his father Marquis Liwu as Emperor Xiaochong, and requested that the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices determine the posthumous titles.

sentences.zh: 刑部侍郎、權判太常卿馬縞復議曰：「伏準兩漢故事，以諸侯王宗室入承帝統，則必追尊父祖，修樹園陵，西漢宣帝、東漢光武，孝饗之道，故事具存。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Justice and Acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ma Gao submitted a further deliberation, saying: "We humbly follow the precedents of both Han dynasties: when a feudal prince of the imperial clan succeeded to the imperial line, he would necessarily posthumously honor father and grandfather, construct park tombs—the ways of filial sacrifice by Emperor Xuan of Western Han and Emperor Guangwu of Eastern Han are fully preserved in precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Justice and Acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ma Gao submitted a further opinion: "We respectfully follow the precedents of both Han dynasties: when a member of the imperial clan succeeded to the throne, he invariably posthumously honored his father and grandfather and constructed park tombs. The filial sacrifices of Emperor Xuan of Western Han and Emperor Guangwu of Eastern Han are fully documented in precedent.

sentences.zh: 自安帝入嗣，遂有皇太后令，別崇謚法，追曰某皇，所謂孝德、孝穆之類是也。

translations.literal: From Emperor An's succession onward, there was an empress dowager's order establishing a separate system of posthumous titles, posthumously styling them as a certain Huang—the so-called Xiaode, Xiaomu, and the like are examples.
translations.idiomatic: From Emperor An's succession onward, there was an empress dowager's order establishing a separate system of posthumous titles, posthumously styling forebears as a certain Huang—Emperor Xiaode, Emperor Xiaomu, and the like.

sentences.zh: 前代惟孫皓自烏程侯繼嗣，追父和為文皇帝，事出非常，不堪垂訓。

translations.literal: In previous ages only Sun Hao, succeeding from Marquis of Wucheng, posthumously honored his father He as Emperor Wen—a matter arising outside the norm, unfit to serve as instruction.
translations.idiomatic: In earlier ages only Sun Hao, succeeding from Marquis of Wucheng, posthumously honored his father He as Emperor Wen—an exceptional case unfit to serve as precedent.

sentences.zh: 今據禮院狀，漢安帝以下，若據本紀，又不見「帝」字。

translations.literal: Now according to the memorial from the Directorate of Rites, from Emperor An of Han onward, if one consults the basic annals, the character Di is also not found.
translations.idiomatic: According to the memorial from the Directorate of Rites, from Emperor An of Han onward, if one consults the basic annals, the character Di ('emperor') is also absent.

sentences.zh: 伏以謚法「德象天地曰帝」。

translations.literal: We humbly consider that in the rules of posthumous titles, 'virtue resembling Heaven and Earth is called Di.'
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully note that according to the rules of posthumous titles, 'virtue resembling Heaven and Earth is called Di.'

sentences.zh: 伏緣禮院已曾奏聞，難將兩漢故事，便述尊名，請詔百官集議。

translations.literal: We humbly note that the Directorate of Rites has already memorialized on this matter; it is difficult to apply the Han precedents directly in stating honorific names—we request an edict summoning the officials to collective deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Rites has already reported on this matter; it is difficult to apply Han precedents directly in determining honorific titles. We request that Your Majesty summon the officials to collective deliberation.

sentences.zh: 」時右僕射李琪等議曰：「伏睹歷代已來，宗廟成制，繼襲無異，沿革或殊。

translations.literal: " At that time Right Vice Director Li Qi and others deliberated, saying: "We humbly observe that through the ages, the established institutions of ancestral temples in succession have been without difference, though modifications in practice may vary.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time Right Vice Director Li Qi and others submitted their opinion: "We respectfully observe that through the ages, the established institutions of ancestral temples have been consistent in succession, though modifications in practice may vary.

sentences.zh: 馬縞所奏，禮有按據，乞下制命，令馬縞虔依典冊，以述尊名。

translations.literal: Ma Gao's memorial has textual authority in the rites; we beg that a regulatory order be issued directing Ma Gao reverently to follow the canonical records in stating the honorific names.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Gao's memorial has solid grounding in ritual precedent; we request that a regulatory order be issued directing Ma Gao to follow the canonical records faithfully in determining the honorific titles.

sentences.zh: 」時明宗意欲兼加「帝」字，乃下詔曰：「朕聞開國承家，得以制禮作樂，故三皇不相襲，五帝不相沿，隨代創規，於禮無爽。

translations.literal: " At that time Emperor Mingzong wished to add the character Di as well, and issued an edict saying: "We have heard that founding a state and continuing a family line permit one to institute rites and compose music; therefore the Three August Ones did not inherit from one another, the Five Thearchs did not continue one another's practices—each age created its own regulations, without violation of the rites.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time Emperor Mingzong wished to add the character Di as well and issued an edict: "We have heard that founding a state and continuing a family line permit one to institute rites and compose music. The Three August Ones did not inherit from one another, the Five Thearchs did not continue one another's practices—each age created its own regulations without violating ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 矧或情關祖禰，事系烝嘗。

translations.literal: How much more when feeling is bound to ancestors and the matter concerns seasonal sacrifices!
translations.idiomatic: How much more when one's feelings are bound to one's ancestors and the matter concerns the seasonal sacrifices!

sentences.zh: 且追謚追尊，稱皇與帝，既有減增之字，合陳褒貶之辭。

translations.literal: Moreover, in posthumous titles and posthumous honors, styling as Huang and Di—since there are characters of diminution and augmentation, praise and censure should be jointly expressed.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in posthumous titles and honors, the designations Huang and Di involve characters of praise and censure; the appropriate evaluative language should be employed.

sentences.zh: 大約二名俱為尊稱，若三皇之代故不可加帝，五帝之代不可言皇。

translations.literal: Broadly speaking, both names are honorific titles; in the age of the Three August Ones one could not add Di, in the age of the Five Thearchs one could not speak of Huang.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly speaking, both titles are honorific designations; in the age of the Three August Ones one could not add Di, and in the age of the Five Thearchs one could not speak of Huang.

sentences.zh: 爰自秦朝，便兼二號。

translations.literal: From the Qin dynasty onward, both titles were combined.
translations.idiomatic: From the Qin dynasty onward, both titles were used together.

sentences.zh: 至若玄元皇帝，事隔千祀，宗追一源，猶顯冊於鴻名，豈須遵於漢典。

translations.literal: As for the August Emperor of the Mysterious Origin, though the matter spans a thousand sacrifices and the ancestral line traces to a single source, he still received a resplendent title in the great name—why must one follow the Han canon?
translations.idiomatic: As for the August Emperor of the Mysterious Origin (Laozi), though a thousand years intervene and the ancestral line traces to a single source, he still received a resplendent honorific title—why must one follow Han precedent?

sentences.zh: 況朕居九五之位，為億兆之尊，不可總二名於眇躬，惜一字於先代，茍隨執議，何表孝誠！

translations.literal: Moreover, We occupy the position of the nine-and-five, the honor of the hundred millions—We cannot combine both titles upon Our slight person and spare a single character for the former generation; if We merely follow rigid deliberation, how would We express filial sincerity!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, We occupy the throne, the honor of the hundred millions—we cannot combine both titles upon our own person yet withhold a single character for our forebears; if we merely follow rigid deliberation, how would we express our filial devotion!

sentences.zh: 可委宰臣與百官詳定，集兩班於中書，逐班各陳所見。

translations.literal: Let this be entrusted to the chief ministers and the hundred officials for detailed determination; assemble both cohorts at the Secretariat, each cohort stating its views in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be entrusted to the chief ministers and the hundred officials for detailed determination; assemble both cohorts of officials at the Secretariat, each to state its views in turn.

sentences.zh: 」惟李琪等請於祖禰二室先加「帝」字。

translations.literal: " Only Li Qi and others requested that the character Di be added first to the two chambers of the great-great-grandfather and great-grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: " Only Li Qi and others requested that the character Di be added first to the two chambers of the remote ancestors.

sentences.zh: 宰臣合眾議奏曰：「恭以朝廷之重，宗廟為先，事系承祧，義符致美。

translations.literal: The chief ministers, combining the collective deliberation, submitted: "We respectfully consider that in the weight of the court, the ancestral temples come first; the matter concerns continuing the sacrificial line, and the principle accords with achieving perfection.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers, combining the collective deliberation, submitted: "We respectfully consider that in the weight of the court, the ancestral temples come first; the matter concerns continuing the sacrificial line, and the principle accords with achieving the highest expression of filial devotion.

sentences.zh: 且聖朝追尊之日，即引漢氏舊儀，在漢氏封崇之時，復依何代故事？

translations.literal: Moreover, on the day when the sacred court posthumously honors, it immediately cites the old rites of the Han; but when the Han themselves ennobled and honored, upon what age's precedents did they rely?
translations.idiomatic: When our sacred court posthumously honors its forebears, it cites Han precedent—but when the Han themselves ennobled and honored their ancestors, upon what earlier age's precedents did they rely?

sentences.zh: 理關凝滯，未協聖謨；

translations.literal: Reason is bound up with rigidity and does not accord with the sacred design;
translations.idiomatic: Rigid adherence to precedent does not accord with the sacred design;

sentences.zh: 道合變通，方為民則。

translations.literal: the Way accords with flexible adaptation—only then does it become the people's standard.
translations.idiomatic: flexible adaptation in keeping with the Way alone becomes the people's standard.

sentences.zh: 且王者功成治定，制禮作樂，正朔服色，尚有改更，尊祖奉先，何妨沿革。

translations.literal: Moreover, when a king's merit is accomplished and governance settled, he institutes rites and composes music—even the calendar, regalia, and colors may still be changed; in honoring ancestors and serving forebears, what harm in modification?
translations.idiomatic: When a ruler's merit is accomplished and governance settled, he institutes rites and composes music—even the calendar, regalia, and colors may be changed; in honoring ancestors and serving forebears, what objection can there be to modification?

sentences.zh: 若應州必立別廟，即地遠上都。

translations.literal: If a separate temple must be established at Ying Prefecture, the place would be far from the superior capital.
translations.idiomatic: If a separate temple must be established at Ying Prefecture, the location would be far from the capital.

sentences.zh: 今據開元中追尊臯陶為德明皇帝，涼武昭王為興聖皇帝，皆立廟於京都。

translations.literal: Now according to the Kaiyuan era, when Gao Yao was posthumously honored as Emperor Deming and Prince Wuzhao of Liang as Emperor Xingsheng, temples were all established in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaiyuan era, when Gao Yao was posthumously honored as Emperor Deming and Prince Wuzhao of Liang as Emperor Xingsheng, temples were established for both in the capital.

sentences.zh: 臣等商量所議追尊四廟，望依御劄並加皇帝之號，兼請於洛京立廟。

translations.literal: We your subjects, in deliberating the four temples proposed for posthumous honor, hope in accordance with the imperial rescript to add the title of emperor to all, and additionally request that temples be established in the Luoyang capital.
translations.idiomatic: We your subjects, in deliberating the four temples proposed for posthumous honor, request that in accordance with the imperial rescript the title of emperor be added to all, and that temples be established in Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 」敕：「宜於應州舊宅立廟，餘依所奏。」

translations.literal: " Edict: "A temple should be established at the old residence in Ying Prefecture; the remainder follows the memorial."
translations.idiomatic: " Edict: "A temple shall be established at the old residence in Ying Prefecture; the remainder follows the memorial."

translations.literal: Editorial bracket opens.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial bracket opens.

sentences.zh: （案《文獻通考》：後唐之所謂七廟者，以沙陀之獻祖國昌、太祖克用、莊宗存勖而上繼唐之高祖、太宗、懿宗、昭宗。

translations.literal: (Note from the Wenxian Tongkao: The so-called seven temples of Later Tang comprised the Shatuo Xianzu Guochang, Taizu Keyong, and Zhuangzong Cunxu, continuing upward to Tang's Gaozu, Taizong, Yizong, and Zhaozong.
translations.idiomatic: (Note from the Wenxian Tongkao: The so-called seven temples of Later Tang comprised the Shatuo ancestors Xianzu Guochang, Taizu Keyong, and Zhuangzong Cunxu, continuing upward to Tang's Gaozu, Taizong, Yizong, and Zhaozong.

sentences.zh: 此所謂四廟者，又明宗代北之高、曾、祖、父也。）〉

translations.literal: The so-called four temples mentioned here were again the great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father from the north, honored by Emperor Mingzong.)〉
translations.idiomatic: The so-called four temples mentioned here were the great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father from the north, whom Emperor Mingzong honored.)〉

sentences.zh: 其年八月，太常禮院奏：「莊宗神主以此月十日祔廟，七室之內，合有祧遷。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of that year, the Directorate of Rites memorialized: "Zhuangzong's spirit tablet on the tenth day of this month is to be enshrined in the temple; within the seven chambers, there should be a distancing removal.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of that year, the Directorate of Rites reported: "Zhuangzong's spirit tablet is to be enshrined in the ancestral temple on the tenth day of this month; within the seven chambers, a distancing removal (tia qian) is required.

sentences.zh: 」中書門下奏議，請祧懿祖一室。

translations.literal: " The Secretariat submitted a deliberation requesting the distancing removal of the Yizu chamber.
translations.idiomatic: " The Secretariat submitted its opinion, requesting the distancing removal of the Yizu chamber.

sentences.zh: 後下百僚集議，禮部尚書蕭頃等奏，請從中書所奏，從之。

translations.literal: Subsequently an order was issued for the hundred officials to deliberate collectively; Minister of Rites Xiao Qing and others memorialized requesting compliance with the Secretariat's memorial, and it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: An order was then issued for collective deliberation by the hundred officials. Minister of Rites Xiao Qing and others memorialized in favor of the Secretariat's proposal, and it was approved.

sentences.zh: 應順元年正月，中書門下奏：「太常以大行山陵畢祔廟。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yingshun, the Secretariat memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Sacrifices, because the great journey's mountain tomb is completed, will enshrine the spirit tablet in the temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Yingshun (934), the Secretariat memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Sacrifices reports that upon completion of the late emperor's tomb, his spirit tablet will be enshrined in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 今太廟見饗七室，高祖、太宗、懿宗、昭宗、獻祖、太祖、莊宗，大行升祔，禮合祧遷獻祖，請下尚書省集議。

translations.literal: Now the Grand Temple has seven chambers currently receiving sacrifice: Gaozu, Taizong, Yizong, Zhaozong, Xianzu, Taizu, and Zhuangzong. When the great journey ascends to enshrinement, the rites require distancing removal of Xianzu—we request referral to the Department of State Affairs for collective deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Temple presently has seven chambers receiving sacrifice: Gaozu, Taizong, Yizong, Zhaozong, Xianzu, Taizu, and Zhuangzong. When the late emperor's tablet is enshrined, ritual requires the distancing removal of Xianzu. We request referral to the Department of State Affairs for collective deliberation.

sentences.zh: 」太子少傅盧質等議曰：「臣等以親盡從祧，垂於舊典，疑事無質，素有明文。

translations.literal: " Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent Lu Zhi and others deliberated, saying: "We your subjects consider that when close kin is exhausted one follows distancing removal—this is handed down in the old canon; doubtful matters without substance have always had explicit texts.
translations.idiomatic: " Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent Lu Zhi and others submitted their opinion: "We your subjects observe that when close kin is exhausted, distancing removal applies—this is established in the old canon, and doubtful matters have always been resolved by explicit textual authority.

sentences.zh: 頃莊宗皇帝再造寰區。

translations.literal: Recently Emperor Zhuangzong recreated the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Emperor Zhuangzong restored the realm.

sentences.zh: 復隆宗廟，追三祖於先遠，復四室於本朝，式遇祧遷，旋成沿革。

translations.literal: He restored and elevated the ancestral temples, posthumously honoring three ancestors in the remote past and restoring four chambers for the present dynasty; encountering distancing removal, it immediately became a modification.
translations.idiomatic: He restored and elevated the ancestral temples, posthumously honoring three remote ancestors and restoring four chambers for the present dynasty; when distancing removal arose, precedent was immediately modified.

sentences.zh: 及莊宗升祔，以懿祖從祧，蓋非嗣立之君，所以先遷其室。

translations.literal: When Zhuangzong ascended to enshrinement, Yizu was distanced—probably because he was not the ruler who succeeded to the throne, and therefore his chamber was moved first.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong's tablet was enshrined, Yizu was distanced—presumably because he was not the ruler who had succeeded to the throne, and therefore his chamber was removed first.

sentences.zh: 光武滅新之後，始有追尊之儀，比只在於南陽，元不歸於太廟，引事且疏於故實，此時須稟於新規。

translations.literal: After Guangwu destroyed Xin, there were first the rites of posthumous honor—but these were only in Nanyang and originally did not return to the Grand Temple; citing this precedent is moreover loose regarding established fact, and at this time one must follow the new regulations.
translations.idiomatic: After Guangwu destroyed the Xin dynasty, posthumous honors were first instituted—but only in Nanyang and not in the Grand Temple. Citing this precedent is loose regarding established fact; at the present time, the new regulations must be followed.

sentences.zh: 將來升祔先廟，次合祧遷獻祖，既協隨時之義，又符變體之文。

translations.literal: In the future, when ascending to enshrinement in the former temple, next Xianzu should be distanced—this both accords with the principle of adapting to the times and matches the text on flexible modification.
translations.idiomatic: When the late emperor's tablet is next enshrined, Xianzu should be distanced next—this accords with adapting to the times and matches the texts on flexible modification.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 時議以懿祖賜姓於懿宗，以支庶系大宗例，宜以懿祖為始祖，次昭宗可也，不必祖神堯而宗太宗。

translations.literal: At the time deliberators held that since Yizu received his surname from Yizong, following the precedent of a collateral line attaching to the great lineage, Yizu should serve as the founding ancestor and Zhaozong next—there was no need to take Shen Yao as ancestor and honor Taizong as the lineage founder.
translations.idiomatic: Contemporary commentators held that since Yizu received his surname from Yizong, following the precedent of a collateral line attaching to the great lineage, Yizu should serve as the founding ancestor with Zhaozong next—there was no need to take Emperor Yao as ancestor and honor Taizong as lineage founder.

sentences.zh: 若依漢光武，則宜於代州立獻祖而下親廟，其唐廟依舊禮行之可也，而議謚者忘咸通之懿宗，又稱懿祖，父子俱「懿」，於理可乎！

translations.literal: If following Han Guangwu, one should establish from Xianzu downward the close temples at Dai Prefecture, and let the Tang temples follow the old rites—but those deliberating posthumous titles forgot Yizong of Xiantong and again styled Yizu, father and son both bearing Yi—is this reasonable!
translations.idiomatic: If following Emperor Guangwu of Han, one should establish the close temples from Xianzu downward at Dai Prefecture and let the Tang temples follow the old rites. Yet those deliberating posthumous titles forgot Yizong of the Xiantong era and again styled Yizu—father and son both bearing Yi—is this reasonable!

sentences.zh: 將朱耶三世與唐室四廟連敘昭穆，非禮之甚也。

translations.literal: To link three generations of the Zhuoye clan with four temples of the Tang house in continuous zhaomu sequence is a grave violation of the rites.
translations.idiomatic: To link three generations of the Zhuoye (Shatuo) clan with four Tang ancestral temples in continuous zhaomu sequence is a grave violation of ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 議祧者不知受氏於唐懿宗而祧之，今又及獻祖。

translations.literal: Those deliberating distancing removal did not know that having received the surname from Tang's Yizong, he was distanced—and now it extends to Xianzu as well.
translations.idiomatic: Those deliberating distancing removal did not understand that Yizu, having received the surname from Tang's Yizong, was already distanced—and now they propose to distance Xianzu as well.

sentences.zh: 以禮論之，始祧昭宗，次祧獻祖可也，而懿祖如唐景皇帝，豈可祧乎？

translations.literal: Discussing it according to the rites, one should first distance Zhaozong, and next distance Xianzu would be acceptable—but Yizu is like Tang's Emperor Jing, how could he be distanced?
translations.idiomatic: According to ritual propriety, Zhaozong should be distanced first, and Xianzu next would be acceptable—but Yizu is like Tang's Emperor Jing; how could he be distanced?

sentences.zh: 晉天福二年正月，中書門下奏：「皇帝到京，未立宗廟，望令所司速具制度典禮以聞。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Tianfu of Jin, the Secretariat memorialized: "The emperor has arrived at the capital but ancestral temples have not yet been established; we hope the responsible offices will quickly prepare the institutional regulations and ceremonial rites and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Tianfu (937), the Secretariat memorialized: "The emperor has arrived at the capital but ancestral temples have not yet been established. We request that the responsible offices quickly prepare the institutional regulations and ceremonial rites and report.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 二月，太常埔士段颙議曰：

translations.literal: In the second month, Court of Imperial Sacrifices Academician Duan Yong deliberated, saying:
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Academician Duan Yong of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices submitted his opinion:

sentences.zh: 夫宗廟之制，歷代為難，須考禮經，以求故事。

translations.literal: The institution of ancestral temples has been difficult through the ages; one must examine the ritual classics to seek precedents.
translations.idiomatic: The institution of ancestral temples has posed difficulties through the ages; one must examine the ritual classics to seek precedents.

sentences.zh: 謹按《尚書·舜典》曰：「正月上日，受終於文祖。

translations.literal: We respectfully note that the "Canon of Shun" in the Book of Documents says: "On the first day of the first month, he received the conclusion at Wenzu.
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully note that the "Canon of Shun" in the Book of Documents states: "On the first day of the first month, he received the conclusion of the mandate at Wenzu (the Cultured Ancestor)."

sentences.zh: 」此是堯之廟也，猶未載其數。

translations.literal: " This was Yao's temple, yet the number is still not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: " This was Yao's temple, yet the number of temples is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 又按《郊祀錄》曰：夏立五廟，商立六廟，周立七廟。

translations.literal: We further note that the Record of Suburban Sacrifices says: Xia established five temples, Shang six, Zhou seven.
translations.idiomatic: We further note that the Record of Suburban Sacrifices states: Xia established five temples, Shang six, and Zhou seven.

sentences.zh: 漢初立祖宗廟於郡國，共計一百六十七所。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Han, ancestral temples were established in commanderies and kingdoms, totaling one hundred sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Han, ancestral temples were established in commanderies and kingdoms, totaling one hundred sixty-seven in all.

sentences.zh: 後漢光武中興後，別立六廟。

translations.literal: After Emperor Guangwu of Later Han restored the dynasty, six temples were separately established.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Guangwu of Later Han restored the dynasty, six temples were separately established.

sentences.zh: 魏明帝初立親廟四，後重議依周法立七廟。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming of Wei at first established four close temples, then after renewed deliberation established seven temples following Zhou law.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming of Wei at first established four close temples, then after renewed deliberation established seven temples following Zhou practice.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝受禪，初立六廟，後復立七廟。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Jin received the abdication, first establishing six temples, then later restoring seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu of Jin received the abdication, he first established six temples, then later restored seven.

sentences.zh: 宋武帝初立六廟，齊朝亦立六廟。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Song at first established six temples; the Qi dynasty also established six temples.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Song first established six temples; the Qi dynasty also established six.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝受命，初立親廟四，至大業元年，煬帝欲遵周法，議立七廟。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen of Sui received the mandate, first establishing four close temples; by the first year of Daye, Emperor Yang wished to follow Zhou law and deliberated establishing seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui received the mandate, he first established four close temples; by the first year of Daye (605), Emperor Yang wished to follow Zhou practice and deliberated establishing seven temples.

sentences.zh: 次屬傳禪於唐，武德元年六月四日，始立四廟於長安，至貞觀九年，命有司詳議廟制，遂立七廟，至開元十一年後，創立九廟。

translations.literal: Next the succession passed to Tang; on the fourth day of the sixth month of the first year of Wude, four temples were first established in Chang'an; by the ninth year of Zhenguan, an order was issued for the responsible offices to deliberate in detail on the temple system, and seven temples were then established; by the eleventh year of Kaiyuan and after, nine temples were created.
translations.idiomatic: The succession then passed to Tang. On the fourth day of the sixth month of the first year of Wude (618), four temples were first established in Chang'an. By the ninth year of Zhenguan (635), the responsible offices were ordered to deliberate on the temple system in detail, and seven temples were established. By the eleventh year of Kaiyuan (723) and after, nine temples were created.

sentences.zh: 又按《禮記·喪服小記》曰：「王者禘其祖之所自出，以其祖配之，而立四廟。

translations.literal: We further note that the "Record of Mourning Garments, Small Treatise" in the Book of Rites says: "The king performs di to the one from whom his ancestor sprang, matching him with his ancestor, and establishes four temples.
translations.idiomatic: We further note that the "Record of Mourning Garments, Small Treatise" in the Book of Rites states: "The king performs the great di sacrifice to the one from whom his ancestor sprang, matching him with his ancestor, and establishes four temples."

sentences.zh: 」鄭玄註云：高祖巳下至禰四世，即親盡也，更立始祖為不遷之廟，共五廟也。

translations.literal: " Zheng Xuan's commentary says: From Gaozu down to Mi is four generations, which is the exhaustion of close kin; then the founding ancestor is further established as the non-distanced temple—five temples in all.
translations.idiomatic: " Zheng Xuan's commentary explains: From Gaozu down to Mi is four generations—the exhaustion of close kin. The founding ancestor is then established as the non-distanced temple, making five temples in all.

sentences.zh: 又按《禮記·祭法》及《王制》、《孔子家語》、《春秋穀梁傳》並云：天子七廟，諸侯五廟，大夫三廟，士一廟。

translations.literal: We further note that the "Record of Sacrifices," "Royal Regulations," Confucian Family Sayings, and Guliang Commentary to the Spring and Autumn Annals all say: the Son of Heaven seven temples, feudal lords five, grandees three, officers one.
translations.idiomatic: The "Record of Sacrifices," "Royal Regulations," Confucian Family Sayings, and Guliang Commentary to the Spring and Autumn Annals all state: the Son of Heaven seven temples, feudal lords five, grandees three, and officers one.

sentences.zh: 此是降殺以兩之義。

translations.literal: This is the principle of descending and reducing by pairs.
translations.idiomatic: This reflects the principle of descending rank by pairs.

sentences.zh: 又按《尚書·咸有一德》曰：「七世之廟，可以觀德。

translations.literal: We further note that the "Common Possession of Pure Virtue" in the Book of Documents says: "The temple of seven generations can display virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The "Common Possession of Pure Virtue" in the Book of Documents states: "The temple of seven generations can display virtue."

sentences.zh: 」又按《疑義》云：天子立七廟，或四廟，蓋有其義也。

translations.literal: " We further note that the Doubts and Explanations says: the Son of Heaven establishes seven temples, or four temples—probably each has its rationale.
translations.idiomatic: " The Doubts and Explanations observes that the Son of Heaven may establish seven temples or four—each arrangement has its rationale.

sentences.zh: 如四廟者，從禰至高祖已下親盡，故有四廟之理。

translations.literal: As for four temples: from Mi up to Gaozu, close kin below is exhausted—hence the rationale for four temples.
translations.idiomatic: As for four temples: from Mi up to Gaozu, close kin is exhausted below—hence the rationale for four temples.

sentences.zh: 又立七廟者，緣自古聖王，祖有功，宗有德，更封立始祖，即於四親廟之外，或祖功宗德，不拘定數，所以有五廟、六廟，或七廟、九廟，欲後代子孫觀其功德，故《尚書》云「七世之廟，可以觀德」矣。

translations.literal: As for establishing seven temples: since ancient sage-kings honored ancestors for merit and lineage founders for virtue, additionally enfeoffing and establishing the founding ancestor beyond the four close temples—or honoring ancestral merit and lineage virtue without fixed numbers—therefore there are five, six, or seven, or nine temples, so that later generations of descendants may observe their merit and virtue; hence the Book of Documents says, 'The temple of seven generations can display virtue.'
translations.idiomatic: As for seven temples: since ancient sage-kings honored ancestors for merit and lineage founders for virtue, additionally enfeoffing and establishing the founding ancestor beyond the four close temples—or honoring ancestral merit and lineage virtue without fixed numbers—there arose five, six, seven, or nine temples, so that later generations might observe their merit and virtue. Hence the Book of Documents says, "The temple of seven generations can display virtue."

sentences.zh: 又按周舍論云：「自江左已來，晉、宋、齊、梁相承，多立七廟。

translations.literal: We further note that Zhou She's treatise says: "From the left of the Yangtze onward, Jin, Song, Qi, and Liang in succession mostly established seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou She's treatise observes: "From the Eastern Jin onward, Jin, Song, Qi, and Liang in succession mostly established seven temples."

sentences.zh: 」今臣等參詳，唯立七廟，即並通其理。

translations.literal: " We your subjects, in comparative examination, hold that establishing only seven temples comprehends both rationales.
translations.idiomatic: " We your subjects, upon comparative examination, hold that establishing seven temples alone comprehends both rationales.

sentences.zh: 伏緣宗廟事大，不敢執以一理定之，故檢七廟、四廟二件之文，俱得其宜，他所論者，並皆勿取。

translations.literal: We humbly note that the matter of ancestral temples is weighty; we dare not adhere to a single rationale to fix it—therefore we have examined texts on both seven temples and four temples, finding both appropriate; other arguments should all be rejected.
translations.idiomatic: The matter of ancestral temples is weighty; we dare not adhere to a single rationale. We have therefore examined texts on both seven temples and four temples and find both appropriate; other arguments should be set aside.

sentences.zh: 請下三省集百官詳議。

translations.literal: We request that the Three Departments convene the hundred officials for detailed deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: We request that the Three Departments convene the hundred officials for detailed deliberation.

sentences.zh: 敕旨宜依。

translations.literal: Imperial rescript: Approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial rescript: Approved as proposed.

sentences.zh: 左僕射劉句等議曰：

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Liu Gou and others deliberated, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Liu Gou and others submitted their opinion:

sentences.zh: 臣等今月八日，伏奉敕命於尚書省集議太常博士段颙所議宗廟事。

translations.literal: We your subjects on the eighth day of this month humbly received the edict ordering collective deliberation at the Department of State Affairs on the matter of ancestral temples deliberated by Court of Imperial Sacrifices Academician Duan Yong.
translations.idiomatic: We your subjects, on the eighth day of this month, humbly received the edict ordering collective deliberation at the Department of State Affairs on Academician Duan Yong's proposal regarding ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 伏以將敷至化，以達萬方，克致平和，必先宗廟。

translations.literal: I respectfully consider that in spreading the utmost transformation to reach the myriad regions and achieving peace and harmony, one must first take the ancestral temples as the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: It is respectfully submitted that to spread the highest civilizing influence to all corners of the realm and attain peace and harmony, the ancestral temples must be established first.

sentences.zh: 故《禮記·王制》云：「天子七廟，諸侯五廟，大夫三廟。

translations.literal: Therefore the 'Royal Regulations' chapter of the Book of Rites says: 'The Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five temples, and grand masters three temples.'
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Book of Rites, Royal Regulations, states: "The Son of Heaven maintains seven ancestral temples, feudal lords five, and grand masters three."

sentences.zh: 」疏云：「周制之七者，太祖廟及文王、武王之祧，與親廟四。

translations.literal: " The commentary says: "Of the Zhou system's seven, there are the Great Ancestor Temple and the distant temples of King Wen and King Wu, together with four temples of near ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: " The commentary explains: "Under the Zhou system, the seven temples comprise the Great Ancestor Temple, the distant-line temples of Kings Wen and Wu, and four temples for immediate ancestors.

sentences.zh: 太祖，後稷也。

translations.literal: The Great Ancestor is Hou Ji.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Ancestor is Hou Ji.

sentences.zh: 商六廟，契及湯與二昭、二穆。

translations.literal: The Shang had six temples: Qi, Tang, and two zhao and two mu.
translations.idiomatic: The Shang maintained six temples—for Qi and Tang, together with two zhao and two mu.

sentences.zh: 夏則五廟，無太祖，禹與二昭、二穆而已。

translations.literal: The Xia had five temples, with no Great Ancestor—only Yu and two zhao and two mu.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia had five temples, with no Great Ancestor Temple—only Yu, together with two zhao and two mu.

sentences.zh: 自夏及周，少不減五，多不過七。

translations.literal: From the Xia through the Zhou, the number was never less than five and never more than seven.
translations.idiomatic: From the Xia through the Zhou, the number of temples was never fewer than five and never more than seven.

sentences.zh: 」又云：「天子七廟，皆據周也。

translations.literal: It also says: "The Son of Heaven's seven temples are all based on the Zhou system.
translations.idiomatic: It further states: "The Son of Heaven's seven temples all follow the Zhou model.

sentences.zh: 有其人則七，無其人則五。

translations.literal: If there is such a person, there are seven; if there is no such person, there are five.
translations.idiomatic: When the requisite figure exists, there are seven temples; when he does not, there are five.

sentences.zh: 若諸侯廟制，雖有其人，則不過五。

translations.literal: As for the temple system of feudal lords, even if there is such a person, the number does not exceed five.
translations.idiomatic: In the case of feudal lords, even when the requisite figure exists, the number of temples does not exceed five.

sentences.zh: 此則天子、諸侯七、五之異明矣。

translations.literal: Thus the difference between seven and five for the Son of Heaven and feudal lords is clear.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the distinction between seven temples for the Son of Heaven and five for feudal lords is plainly established.

sentences.zh: 」至於三代已後魏、晉、宋、齊、隋及唐初，多立六廟或四廟，蓋於建國之始，不盈七廟之數也。

translations.literal: As for the three dynasties and afterward—Wei, Jin, Song, Qi, Sui, and the early Tang—many established six temples or four temples, because at the founding of the state they did not fill the number of seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: From the Three Dynasties onward, through Wei, Jin, Song, Qi, Sui, and the early Tang, many dynasties established six temples or four, since at the founding of a state the full complement of seven was not yet reached.

sentences.zh: 今欲請立自高祖已下四親廟，其始祖一廟，未敢輕議，伏俟聖裁。

translations.literal: Now we wish to request establishing four temples of near ancestors from the High Ancestor downward, and a separate temple for the Founding Ancestor—we dare not lightly decide this and respectfully await the sage decision.
translations.idiomatic: We now propose establishing four temples for immediate ancestors from the High Ancestor downward, plus a separate temple for the Founding Ancestor; we dare not decide this lightly and respectfully await Your Majesty's ruling.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞張昭遠奏議曰：

translations.literal: The Censor-in-Chief Zhang Zhaoyuan submitted a memorial stating:
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Zhang Zhaoyuan submitted the following memorial:

sentences.zh: 臣前月中預都省集議宗廟事，伏見議狀於親廟之外，請別立始祖一廟，近奏中書門下牒，再令百官於都省議定聞奏者。

translations.literal: Your subject last month participated in the joint deliberation at the Department of State Affairs on ancestral temples, and respectfully saw in the deliberation record that, apart from the temples of near ancestors, a separate temple for the Founding Ancestor was requested; recently a dispatch from the Secretariat and Chancellery again ordered all officials to deliberate at the Department of State Affairs, decide, and report.
translations.idiomatic: Last month your subject took part in the joint deliberation at the Department of State Affairs on ancestral temples. I respectfully noted that, in addition to the temples of immediate ancestors, the proposal called for a separate Founding Ancestor Temple. A recent dispatch from the Secretariat and Chancellery has again ordered all officials to meet at the Department of State Affairs, reach a decision, and report to the throne.

sentences.zh: 臣讀十四代史書，見二千年故事，觀諸家宗廟，都無始祖之稱，唯商、周二代，以稷、契為太祖。

translations.literal: Your subject has read the histories of fourteen dynasties, seen two thousand years of precedent, and observed the ancestral temples of various houses—nowhere is there a title of Founding Ancestor; only in the Shang and Zhou dynasties were Ji and Qi taken as Great Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: I have read the histories of fourteen dynasties, reviewed two thousand years of precedent, and examined the ancestral temples of successive houses. Nowhere do I find the title "Founding Ancestor." Only in the Shang and Zhou dynasties were Ji and Qi honored as Great Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 《禮記》曰：「天子七廟，三昭、三穆，與太祖之廟而七。

translations.literal: The Book of Rites says: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples—three zhao, three mu, and the temple of the Great Ancestor, making seven.
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Rites states: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the Great Ancestor Temple, making seven in all.

sentences.zh: 」鄭玄註：「此周制也。

translations.literal: " Zheng Xuan's commentary: "This is the Zhou system.
translations.idiomatic: " Zheng Xuan annotates: "This is the Zhou system.

sentences.zh: 七者，太祖後稷及文王、武王與四親廟。

translations.literal: The seven are the Great Ancestor Hou Ji, Kings Wen and Wu, and four temples of near ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: The seven are the Great Ancestor Hou Ji, Kings Wen and Wu, and four temples for immediate ancestors.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「商人六廟，契及成湯與二昭、二穆也。

translations.literal: " It also says: "The Shang people had six temples—Qi and Cheng Tang, together with two zhao and two mu.
translations.idiomatic: " It further states: "The Shang maintained six temples—for Qi and Cheng Tang, together with two zhao and two mu.

sentences.zh: 夏後氏立五廟，不立太祖，惟禹與二昭、二穆而已。

translations.literal: The Xia dynasty established five temples, did not establish a Great Ancestor, and had only Yu with two zhao and two mu.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia established five temples, with no Great Ancestor Temple—only Yu, together with two zhao and two mu.

sentences.zh: 」據《王制》鄭玄所釋，即商、周以稷、契為太祖，夏後無太祖，亦無追謚之廟。

translations.literal: " According to Zheng Xuan's explanation of the Royal Regulations, the Shang and Zhou took Ji and Qi as Great Ancestors, while the Xia had no Great Ancestor and no temple of posthumous ennoblement.
translations.idiomatic: " According to Zheng Xuan's commentary on the Royal Regulations, the Shang and Zhou honored Ji and Qi as Great Ancestors, whereas the Xia had neither a Great Ancestor nor a temple of posthumous ennoblement.

sentences.zh: 自商、周以來，時更十代，皆於親廟之中，以有功者為太祖，無追崇始祖之例。

translations.literal: From the Shang and Zhou onward, through ten generations of change, all placed the meritorious within the temples of near ancestors as Great Ancestor, with no precedent of posthumously elevating a Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: From the Shang and Zhou onward, through ten generations of dynastic change, each house designated as Great Ancestor someone meritorious within the temples of immediate ancestors; there is no precedent for posthumously elevating a separate Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 具引今古，即恐詞繁，事要證明，須陳梗概。

translations.literal: To cite all ancient and modern cases in full would make the language prolix; the essential point must be proved, so I shall set forth the outline.
translations.idiomatic: A full citation of every ancient and modern case would make this memorial unwieldy; since the essential point must be established, I shall present only the main outlines.

sentences.zh: 漢以高祖父太上皇執嘉無社稷功，不立廟號，高帝自為高祖。

translations.literal: Han took the great-grandfather, the Supreme Emperor Zhijia, who had no merit to the altars of soil and grain, and did not establish a temple title; the High Emperor made himself the High Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: In Han, the great-grandfather, Supreme Emperor Zhijia, had rendered no service to the state and received no temple title; the High Emperor himself became the High Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 魏以曹公相漢，垂三十年，始封於魏，故為太祖。

translations.literal: Wei took Duke Cao, who assisted Han for nearly thirty years and was first enfeoffed in Wei, and therefore made him Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: In Wei, Duke Cao had assisted Han for nearly thirty years and was first enfeoffed as ruler of Wei; he was therefore made Great Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 晉以宣王輔魏有功，立為高祖，以景帝始封晉，故為太祖。

translations.literal: Jin took the Illustrious King, who assisted Wei with merit, and established him as High Ancestor; the Brilliant Emperor was first enfeoffed in Jin and therefore became Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: In Jin, the Illustrious King, who had served Wei with distinction, was established as High Ancestor; the Brilliant Emperor was first enfeoffed as ruler of Jin and therefore became Great Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 宋氏先世，官閥卑微，雖追崇帝號，劉裕自為高祖。

translations.literal: The Song clan's earlier generations held humble official rank; although they were posthumously honored with imperial titles, Liu Yu made himself the High Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: The Liu clan of Song came from humble official origins; though earlier generations were posthumously granted imperial titles, Liu Yu himself became the High Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 南齊高帝之父，位至右將軍，生無封爵，不得為太祖，高帝自為太祖。

translations.literal: In Southern Qi, the High Emperor's father rose only to Right General; having received no enfeoffment in life, he could not be Great Ancestor, and the High Emperor made himself Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: In Southern Qi, the High Emperor's father rose only to the rank of Right General; since he had received no enfeoffment in life, he could not be made Great Ancestor, and the High Emperor himself became Great Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 梁武帝父順之，佐佑齊室，封侯，位至領軍、丹陽尹，雖不受封於梁，亦為太祖。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Liang's father Shunzhi assisted the Qi house, was enfeoffed as marquis, and rose to Commander-in-Chief and Governor of Danyang; although he received no enfeoffment from Liang, he was still made Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Liang's father, Shunzhi, had supported the Qi house, was enfeoffed as marquis, and rose to Commander-in-Chief and Governor of Danyang; though he received no enfeoffment from Liang, he was nonetheless made Great Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 陳武帝父文贊，生無名位，以武帝功，梁室贈侍中，封義興公，及武帝即位，亦追為太祖。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Chen's father Wenzan had no fame or rank in life; because of the Emperor's merit, the Liang house posthumously granted him Palace Attendant and enfeoffed him as Duke of Yixing, and when the Emperor ascended the throne he was also posthumously made Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Chen's father, Wenzan, held no rank or title in life; on account of the Emperor's achievements, the Liang house posthumously granted him the title of Palace Attendant and enfeoffed him as Duke of Yixing, and when the Emperor took the throne he too was posthumously made Great Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 周閔帝以父泰相西魏，經營王業，始封於周，故為太祖。

translations.literal: Emperor Min of Zhou took his father Tai, who had served as chancellor of Western Wei and managed the royal enterprise and was first enfeoffed in Zhou, and therefore made him Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Min of Northern Zhou made his father Tai Great Ancestor, for Tai had served as chancellor of Western Wei, managed the founding of the Zhou house, and was first enfeoffed as its ruler.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝父忠，輔周室有大功，始封於隋，故為太祖。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen of Sui's father Zhong rendered great merit assisting the Zhou house and was first enfeoffed in Sui, and therefore became Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen of Sui's father, Zhong, rendered great service to the Zhou house and was first enfeoffed as ruler of Sui; he therefore became Great Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 唐高祖神堯祖父虎為周八柱國，隋代追封唐公，故為太祖。

translations.literal: Tang's High Ancestor, the Divine and Sagely Emperor, took his grandfather Hu, who was one of the Eight Pillar Dukes of Zhou and was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Tang in the Sui, and therefore made him Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Tang's High Ancestor, the Divine and Sagely Emperor, made his grandfather Hu Great Ancestor; Hu had been one of the Eight Pillar Dukes of Zhou and was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Tang under the Sui.

sentences.zh: 唐末梁室朱氏有帝位，亦立四廟，朱公先世無名位，雖追冊四廟，不立太祖，朱公自為太祖。

translations.literal: At the end of Tang, the Zhu clan of Liang held the imperial throne and also established four temples; the Zhu lord's earlier generations had no fame or rank, and although four temples were posthumously established, no Great Ancestor was set up—the Zhu lord himself became Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Tang, the Zhu house of Liang took the throne and likewise established four temples. The Zhu lord's forebears had held no rank or title; though four temples were posthumously established, no Great Ancestor was designated—the Zhu lord himself became Great Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 此則前代追冊太祖，不出親廟之成例也。

translations.literal: Thus in previous generations the posthumous establishment of a Great Ancestor did not depart from the established precedent within the temples of near ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Thus in previous dynasties, the posthumous establishment of a Great Ancestor never departed from the established practice within the temples of immediate ancestors.

sentences.zh: 王者祖有功而宗有德，漢、魏之制，非有功德不得立為祖宗，商、周受命，以稷、契有大功於唐、虞之際，故追尊為太祖。

translations.literal: The king honors the meritorious as ancestor and the virtuous as object of veneration; in the systems of Han and Wei, without merit and virtue one could not be established as ancestor or object of veneration. When Shang and Zhou received the Mandate, they posthumously honored Ji and Qi as Great Ancestors because of their great merit in the age of Tang and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: A true king takes the meritorious as his ancestor and the virtuous as his object of veneration. Under Han and Wei, without merit and virtue one could not be established as an ancestral or venerable figure. When Shang and Zhou received the Mandate, they posthumously honored Ji and Qi as Great Ancestors because of their great service in the age of Tang and Yu.

sentences.zh: 自秦、漢之後，其禮不然，雖祖有功，仍須親廟。

translations.literal: From Qin and Han onward the rites were not so; although one might honor the meritorious as ancestor, one still had to remain within the temples of near ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: From Qin and Han onward, the rites were not applied in this way; even when honoring the meritorious as ancestor, the designation still had to remain within the temples of immediate ancestors.

sentences.zh: 今亦粗言往例，以取證明。

translations.literal: I shall now speak roughly of past precedents to obtain proof.
translations.idiomatic: I shall now briefly review past precedents by way of proof.

sentences.zh: 秦稱造父之後，不以造父為始祖；

translations.literal: Qin called itself descendant of Zaofu, yet did not take Zaofu as Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Qin claimed descent from Zaofu, yet did not make Zaofu its Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 漢稱唐堯、劉累之後，不以堯、累為始祖；

translations.literal: Han called itself descendant of Tang Yao and Liu Lei, yet did not take Yao and Lei as Founding Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Han claimed descent from Tang Yao and Liu Lei, yet did not make Yao or Lei its Founding Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 魏稱曹參之後，不以參為始祖；

translations.literal: Wei called itself descendant of Cao Can, yet did not take Can as Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Wei claimed descent from Cao Can, yet did not make Can its Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 晉稱趙將司馬卬之後，不以卬為始祖；

translations.literal: Jin called itself descendant of the Zhao general Sima Ang, yet did not take Ang as Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Jin claimed descent from the Zhao general Sima Ang, yet did not make Ang its Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 宋稱漢楚元王之後，不以元王為始祖；

translations.literal: Song called itself descendant of the Prince Yuan of Chu of Han, yet did not take the Prince Yuan as Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Song claimed descent from the Prince Yuan of Chu of Han, yet did not make the Prince Yuan its Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 齊、梁皆稱蕭何之後，不以蕭何為始祖；

translations.literal: Qi and Liang both called themselves descendants of Xiao He, yet did not take Xiao He as Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Both Qi and Liang claimed descent from Xiao He, yet neither made Xiao He its Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 陳稱太丘長陳寔之後，不以實為始祖；

translations.literal: Chen called itself descendant of Chen Shi, Prefect of Taqiu, yet did not take Shi as Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Chen claimed descent from Chen Shi, Prefect of Taqiu, yet did not make Shi its Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 元魏稱李陵之後，不以陵為始祖；

translations.literal: Northern Wei called itself descendant of Li Ling, yet did not take Ling as Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei claimed descent from Li Ling, yet did not make Ling its Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 後周稱神農之後，不以神農為始祖；

translations.literal: Later Zhou called itself descendant of Shennong, yet did not take Shennong as Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou claimed descent from Shennong, yet did not make Shennong its Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 隋稱楊震之後，不以楊震為始祖；

translations.literal: Sui called itself descendant of Yang Zhen, yet did not take Yang Zhen as Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Sui claimed descent from Yang Zhen, yet did not make Yang Zhen its Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 唐稱臯陶、老子之後，不以臯陶、老子為始祖。

translations.literal: Tang called itself descendant of Gao Yao and Laozi, yet did not take Gao Yao and Laozi as Founding Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Tang claimed descent from Gao Yao and Laozi, yet did not make Gao Yao or Laozi its Founding Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 唯唐高宗則天武後臨朝，革唐稱周，又立七廟，仍追冊周文王姬昌為始祖，此蓋當時附麗之徒，不諳故實，武立姬廟，乖越已甚，曲臺之人，到今嗤誚。

translations.literal: Only when Empress Wu of the Tang, consort of Emperor Gaozong, held court, changed Tang to Zhou, and again established seven temples did she posthumously ennoble King Wen of Zhou, Ji Chang, as Founding Ancestor—this was because the flatterers of the time did not understand ancient precedent; to rashly establish a temple to Ji was a gross violation, and the scholars of the Quetai still mock it to this day.
translations.idiomatic: Only when Empress Wu, consort of Emperor Gaozong, held court, changed the dynastic name from Tang to Zhou, and re-established seven temples did she posthumously ennoble King Wen of Zhou, Ji Chang, as Founding Ancestor. This was the work of sycophants who did not understand ancient precedent; to rashly establish a temple to Ji was a gross violation, and scholars of the Quetai still ridicule it to this day.

sentences.zh: 臣遠觀秦、漢，下至周、隋，禮樂衣冠，聲明文物，未有如唐室之盛。

translations.literal: Your subject, looking far from Qin and Han down to Northern Zhou and Sui, finds that in ritual, music, dress, reputation, and cultural institutions, none was as flourishing as the Tang house.
translations.idiomatic: Looking from Qin and Han down through Northern Zhou and Sui, I find that in ritual, music, dress, renown, and cultural institutions, none equaled the splendor of the Tang.

sentences.zh: 武德議廟之初，英才間出，如溫、魏、顏、虞通今古，封、蕭、薛、杜達禮儀，制度憲章，必有師法。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the deliberation on temples in the Wude era, talented men appeared one after another—Wen, Wei, Yan, and Yu were versed in ancient and modern matters; Feng, Xiao, Xue, and Du mastered ritual propriety—so that in institutions, laws, and regulations there must have been models to follow.
translations.idiomatic: At the outset of the Wude-era deliberation on ancestral temples, men of talent abounded: Wen, Wei, Yan, and Yu were steeped in ancient and modern learning; Feng, Xiao, Xue, and Du were masters of ritual propriety. In institutions, laws, and regulations, there must have been authoritative models to follow.

sentences.zh: 夫追崇先王、先母之儀，起於周代。

translations.literal: The rites for posthumously honoring former kings and former mothers began in the Zhou dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: The rites for posthumously honoring former kings and former queens originated in the Zhou dynasty.

sentences.zh: 據《史記》及禮經云：「武王纘太王、王季、文王之緒，一戎衣而有天下，尊為天子，宗廟饗之。

translations.literal: According to the Records of the Grand Historian and the ritual classics: "King Wu continued the line of Grand King, King Ji, and King Wen; with one suit of armor he obtained the realm, was honored as Son of Heaven, and offered sacrifices in the ancestral temples.
translations.idiomatic: The Records of the Grand Historian and the ritual classics state: "King Wu continued the line of Grand King, King Ji, and King Wen; clad in armor, he won the realm, was honored as Son of Heaven, and received sacrifice in the ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 周公成文、武之德，追王太王、王季，祀先公以天子之禮。

translations.literal: The Duke of Zhou completed the virtue of Wen and Wu, posthumously enthroned Grand King and King Ji, and sacrificed to the former lords with the rites due to the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Zhou completed the virtue of Kings Wen and Wu, posthumously enthroned Grand King and King Ji, and sacrificed to the former lords with the rites due to the Son of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 」又曰「郊祀後稷以配天。

translations.literal: " It also says: "In suburban sacrifice Hou Ji is offered to match Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: " It further states: "In the suburban sacrifice, Hou Ji is offered to match Heaven.

sentences.zh: 」據此言之，周武雖祀七世，追為王號者，但四世而已。

translations.literal: " According to this, although King Wu of Zhou sacrificed to seven generations, only four generations were posthumously given royal titles.
translations.idiomatic: " On this basis, although King Wu of Zhou sacrificed to seven generations, only four generations received posthumous royal titles.

sentences.zh: 故自東漢以來，有國之初，多崇四廟，從周制也。

translations.literal: Therefore from the Eastern Han onward, at the founding of a state many honored four temples, following the Zhou system.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, from the Eastern Han onward, newly founded dynasties commonly honored four temples, following the Zhou model.

sentences.zh: 況商因夏禮，漢習秦儀，無勞博訪之文，宜約已成之制。

translations.literal: Moreover, Shang adopted the rites of Xia, and Han followed the institutions of Qin—there is no need for extensive inquiry into texts; one should adhere to institutions already established.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Shang adopted the rites of Xia, and Han followed the institutions of Qin; there is no need for exhaustive textual research—we should adhere to institutions already established.

sentences.zh: 請依隋、唐有國之初，創立四廟，推四世之中名位高者為太祖。

translations.literal: I request that, following the precedent of Sui and Tang at the founding of their states, four temples be newly established, and that the one of highest name and rank among the four generations be promoted as Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: I request that, following the precedent of Sui and Tang at the founding of their states, four temples be established, and that the forebear of highest title and rank among those four generations be designated Great Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 謹議以聞。

translations.literal: Respectfully submitted for report.
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully submitted for Your Majesty's consideration.

sentences.zh: 敕：宜令尚書省集百官，將前議狀與張昭遠所陳，速定奪聞奏。

translations.literal: Edict: The Department of State Affairs is ordered to assemble all officials, take the previous deliberation record together with what Zhang Zhaoyuan has stated, and promptly decide and report.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial edict: The Department of State Affairs shall assemble all officials, review the previous deliberation record together with Zhang Zhaoyuan's memorial, and promptly reach a decision and report.

sentences.zh: 左僕射劉句等再議奏曰：

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Liu Gou and others again deliberated and submitted, stating:
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Liu Gou and others submitted a further deliberation, stating:

sentences.zh: 臣等今月十三日，再於尚書省集百官詳議。

translations.literal: Your subjects on the thirteenth of this month again assembled all officials at the Department of State Affairs for detailed deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On the thirteenth of this month, we again assembled all officials at the Department of State Affairs for detailed deliberation.

sentences.zh: 夫王者祖武宗文，郊天祀地，故有追崇之典，以申配饗之儀。

translations.literal: The king honors martial achievement as ancestor and civil virtue as object of veneration; in sacrificing to Heaven and Earth there are rites of posthumous elevation to extend the ceremony of matching sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: A true king honors martial achievement as his ancestor and civil virtue as his object of veneration; in sacrificing to Heaven and Earth, there are rites of posthumous elevation to extend the ceremony of matched offerings.

sentences.zh: 初詳太常禮院議狀，唯立七廟四廟，即並通其理。

translations.literal: On first examining the deliberation record of the Court of Ritual of the Ministry of Ceremonies, the proposal to establish only seven temples or four temples already comprehends the principle in full.
translations.idiomatic: On first examining the deliberation record of the Court of Ritual of the Ministry of Ceremonies, the proposal to establish either seven temples or four temples already comprehends the principle in full.

sentences.zh: 其他所論，並皆勿取。

translations.literal: All other points discussed should not be adopted.
translations.idiomatic: All other points raised in discussion should be rejected.

sentences.zh: 七廟者，按《禮記·王制》曰：「天子七廟，三昭、三穆與太祖之廟而七。

translations.literal: As for seven temples, according to the Book of Rites, Royal Regulations: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples—three zhao, three mu, and the temple of the Great Ancestor, making seven.
translations.idiomatic: As for seven temples, the Book of Rites, Royal Regulations, states: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the Great Ancestor Temple, making seven in all.

sentences.zh: 」鄭玄註云：「此周制也。

translations.literal: " Zheng Xuan's commentary says: "This is the Zhou system.
translations.idiomatic: " Zheng Xuan annotates: "This is the Zhou system.

sentences.zh: 」詳其禮經，即是周家七廟之定數。

translations.literal: " Examining the ritual classics in detail, this is precisely the fixed number of seven temples for the Zhou house.
translations.idiomatic: " A detailed examination of the ritual classics shows that this is precisely the fixed number of seven temples for the Zhou house.

sentences.zh: 四廟者，謂高、曾、祖、禰四世也。

translations.literal: Four temples means the four generations of High Ancestor, Great-Great-Grandfather, Great-Grandfather, and Grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: Four temples refer to the four generations of High Ancestor, Great-Great-Grandfather, Great-Grandfather, and Grandfather.

sentences.zh: 按《周本紀》及《禮記·大傳》皆曰：「武王即位，追王太王、王季、文王。

translations.literal: According to the Basic Annals of Zhou and the Great Tradition chapter of the Book of Rites, both say: "When King Wu took the throne, he posthumously enthroned Grand King, King Ji, and King Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Both the Basic Annals of Zhou and the Great Tradition chapter of the Book of Rites state: "When King Wu took the throne, he posthumously enthroned Grand King, King Ji, and King Wen.

sentences.zh: 以後稷為堯稷官，故追尊為太祖。

translations.literal: Because Hou Ji was the official of grain under Yao, he was posthumously honored as Great Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Because Hou Ji had served as Minister of Agriculture under Yao, he was posthumously honored as Great Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 」此即周武王初有天下，追尊四廟之明文也。

translations.literal: " This is the explicit text on King Wu of Zhou's first possession of the realm and posthumous honoring of four temples.
translations.idiomatic: " This is the explicit record of King Wu of Zhou's first possession of the realm and his posthumous honoring of four temples.

sentences.zh: 故自嘆、魏已降，迄於周、隋，創業之君，追謚不過四世，約周制也。

translations.literal: Therefore from Han and Wei downward, through Northern Zhou and Sui, founding rulers in posthumous ennoblement did not exceed four generations, approximating the Zhou system.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, from Han and Wei onward, through Northern Zhou and Sui, founding rulers in posthumous ennoblement did not exceed four generations, following the Zhou model.

sentences.zh: 此禮行之已久，事在不疑。

translations.literal: This rite has long been in practice; the matter admits no doubt.
translations.idiomatic: This rite has long been in practice; the matter admits no doubt.

sentences.zh: 今參詳都省前議狀，請立四廟外，別引始祖，取裁未為定議。

translations.literal: Now, examining in detail the previous deliberation record of the Department of State Affairs, apart from requesting four temples it also separately cited a Founding Ancestor—the decision has not yet been settled.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the previous deliberation record of the Department of State Affairs, we find that in addition to proposing four temples it also separately invoked a Founding Ancestor—a point on which no final decision has been reached.

sentences.zh: 續準敕據御史中丞張昭遠奏，請創立四廟之外，無別封始祖之文。

translations.literal: Subsequently, according to the edict and based on Censor-in-Chief Zhang Zhaoyuan's memorial, apart from newly establishing four temples there is no text separately enfeoffing a Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently, in accordance with the edict and Zhang Zhaoyuan's memorial, apart from newly establishing four temples there is no provision for separately enfeoffing a Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 況國家禮樂刑名，皆依唐典，宗廟之制，須約舊章。

translations.literal: Moreover, the state's ritual, music, penal law, and nomenclature all follow Tang institutions; the ancestral temple system must adhere to the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the state's ritual, music, penal law, and nomenclature all follow Tang institutions; the ancestral temple system must conform to established Tang precedent.

sentences.zh: 請依唐朝追尊獻祖宣皇帝、懿祖光皇帝、太祖景皇帝、代祖元皇帝故事，追尊四廟為定」

translations.literal: We request that, following the Tang precedent of posthumously honoring the four temples—Imperial Ancestor Xuan, August Ancestor Guang, Great Ancestor Jing, and Founding Ancestor Yuan—the posthumous honoring of four temples be fixed as the rule.
translations.idiomatic: We request that, following the Tang precedent of posthumously honoring Imperial Ancestor Xuan, August Ancestor Guang, Great Ancestor Jing, and Founding Ancestor Yuan, the posthumous honoring of four temples be fixed as the rule.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 七年七月，太常禮院奏：「國朝見饗四廟：靖祖、肅祖、睿祖、憲祖。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the seventh year, the Court of Ritual of the Ministry of Ceremonies submitted: "The present dynasty now sacrifices at four temples: the Pure Ancestor, the Solemn Ancestor, the Wise Ancestor, and the Worthy Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year, the Court of Ritual of the Ministry of Ceremonies submitted: "The present dynasty currently sacrifices at four temples: the Pure Ancestor, the Solemn Ancestor, the Wise Ancestor, and the Worthy Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 今大行皇帝將行升祔，按《會要》：唐武德元年，立四廟於長安；

translations.literal: Now the late emperor is about to undergo elevation and enshrinement; according to the Institutional Essentials: in the first year of Wude of Tang, four temples were established in Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor is now to undergo elevation and enshrinement. According to the Institutional Essentials, in the first year of Wude of Tang, four temples were established in Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 貞觀九年，高祖神堯皇帝崩，命有司詳議廟制，議以高祖神主並舊四室祔廟。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhenguan, when the Divine and Sagely Emperor Gaozu of Tang died, he ordered the relevant offices to deliberate in detail on the temple system; the deliberation was that the spirit tablet of Gaozu should be enshrined together with the four existing chambers.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Zhenguan, when Emperor Gaozu of Tang, the Divine and Sagely Emperor, died, he ordered the relevant offices to deliberate in detail on the temple system; the decision was that Gaozu's spirit tablet should be enshrined together with the four existing chambers.

sentences.zh: 今先帝神主，請同唐高祖升祔。

translations.literal: Now for the late emperor's spirit tablet, we request the same procedure as Tang Gaozu's elevation and enshrinement.
translations.idiomatic: For the late emperor's spirit tablet, we request the same procedure applied to Tang Gaozu's elevation and enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 漢天福十二年閏七月，時漢高祖已即位，尚仍天福之號。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month of the twelfth year of Tianfu of Han, the High Ancestor of Han had already ascended the throne but still retained the Tianfu reign title.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month of the twelfth year of Tianfu of Later Han, the High Ancestor had already ascended the throne but still retained the Tianfu reign title.

sentences.zh: 太常博士段颙奏議曰：「伏以宗廟之制，歷代為難，須按禮經，旁求故實，又緣禮貴隨時，損益不定。

translations.literal: Palace Academician Duan Yong submitted a memorial stating: "I respectfully consider that the ancestral temple system has been difficult in every generation; one must consult the ritual classics and broadly seek ancient precedent, and moreover, since ritual values adapting to the times, additions and subtractions are not fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Academician Duan Yong submitted a memorial stating: "I respectfully submit that the ancestral temple system has posed difficulties in every generation; one must consult the ritual classics and broadly seek ancient precedent, and moreover, since ritual values adapting to the times, additions and subtractions are not fixed.

sentences.zh: 今參詳歷代故事，立高、曾、祖、禰四廟，更上追遠祖光武皇帝為始祖百代不遷之廟，居東向之位，共為五廟，庶符往例，又合禮經。

translations.literal: Now, having examined the precedents of successive generations, I propose establishing four temples for High Ancestor, Great-Great-Grandfather, Great-Grandfather, and Grandfather, and further posthumously honoring the remote ancestor Emperor Guangwu as Founding Ancestor in a temple that would never be displaced through a hundred generations, placed in the east-facing position, making five temples in all—this would accord with past precedent and also conform to the ritual classics.
