translations.idiomatic: Having examined the precedents of successive generations, I propose establishing four temples for the High Ancestor, Great-Great-Grandfather, Great-Grandfather, and Grandfather, and further posthumously honoring the remote ancestor Emperor Guangwu as Founding Ancestor in a permanently undisturbed temple placed in the east-facing position, making five temples in all—thus conforming to past precedent and to the ritual classics.

sentences.zh: 」詔尚書省集百官議。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the Department of State Affairs to assemble all officials for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the Department of State Affairs to assemble all officials for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書竇貞固等議云：「按《禮記·王制》云：「天子七廟，諸侯五廟，大夫三廟。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Dou Zheng'gu and others deliberated, stating: "According to the Book of Rites, Royal Regulations: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five temples, and grand masters three temples.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Dou Zheng'gu and others deliberated, stating: "According to the Book of Rites, Royal Regulations: 'The Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five, and grand masters three.'

sentences.zh: 」疏云：「周制之七廟者，太祖及文王、武王之祧，與親廟四。

translations.literal: " The commentary says: "Of the Zhou system's seven temples, there are the Great Ancestor and the distant temples of Kings Wen and Wu, together with four temples of near ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: " The commentary explains: "Under the Zhou system, the seven temples comprise the Great Ancestor Temple, the distant-line temples of Kings Wen and Wu, and four temples for immediate ancestors.

sentences.zh: 太祖，後稷也。

translations.literal: The Great Ancestor is Hou Ji.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Ancestor is Hou Ji.

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark.

sentences.zh: 又云：「天子七廟，皆據周也。

translations.literal: It also says: "The Son of Heaven's seven temples are all based on the Zhou system.
translations.idiomatic: It further states: "The Son of Heaven's seven temples all follow the Zhou model.

sentences.zh: 有其人則七，無其人則五。

translations.literal: If there is such a person, there are seven; if there is no such person, there are five.
translations.idiomatic: When the requisite figure exists, there are seven temples; when he does not, there are five.

sentences.zh: 」至於光武中興及歷代多立六廟或四廟，蓋建國之始，未盈七廟之數。

translations.literal: As for Guangwu's restoration and successive generations, many established six temples or four temples, because at the founding of the state they did not fill the number of seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: As for Guangwu's restoration and successive dynasties, many established six temples or four, since at the founding of a state the full complement of seven was not yet reached.

sentences.zh: 又按《郊祀錄》王肅云：「德厚者流澤廣，天子可以事六代之義也。

translations.literal: Also according to the Records of Suburban Sacrifice, Wang Su says: "Those of deep virtue spread broad favor; the Son of Heaven may serve the meaning of six generations.
translations.idiomatic: According also to the Records of Suburban Sacrifice, Wang Su states: "Those of deep virtue spread their beneficence widely; the Son of Heaven may observe the principle of six generations.

sentences.zh: 」今欲請立高祖已下四親廟。

translations.literal: " Now we wish to request establishing four temples of near ancestors from the High Ancestor downward.
translations.idiomatic: " We now propose establishing four temples for immediate ancestors from the High Ancestor downward.

sentences.zh: 又自古聖王，祖有功，宗有德，即於四親廟之外，祖功宗德，不拘定數。

translations.literal: Moreover, since ancient sage-kings honored ancestors for merit and lineage founders for virtue, beyond the four temples of near ancestors they honored ancestral merit and lineage virtue without fixed numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, since ancient sage-kings honored ancestors for merit and lineage founders for virtue, beyond the four temples of immediate ancestors they honored ancestral merit and lineage virtue without fixed numbers.

sentences.zh: 今除四親廟外，更請上追高皇帝、光武皇帝，更立六廟。

translations.literal: Now apart from the four temples of near ancestors, we further request posthumously elevating the High Emperor and Emperor Guangwu and additionally establishing six temples.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from the four temples of immediate ancestors, we further request posthumously elevating the High Emperor and Emperor Guangwu and establishing six temples in all.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

translations.literal: Editorial bracket opens.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial bracket opens.

sentences.zh: （《文獻通考》：莊宗、明宗既舍其祖而祖唐之祖矣，及敬瑭、知遠崛起而登帝位，俱欲以華胄自詭，故於四親之外，必求所謂始祖而祖之。

translations.literal: (Wenxian Tongkao: Zhuangzong and Mingzong had already set aside their own ancestors to take Tang's ancestors as their own; when Jingtang and Zhiyuan rose to the throne, both wished to pass themselves off as of illustrious lineage, and therefore beyond the four near ancestors they had to seek a so-called Founding Ancestor to honor.
translations.idiomatic: (Wenxian Tongkao: Zhuangzong and Mingzong had already set aside their own ancestors to honor Tang's ancestors; when Jingtang and Zhiyuan rose to the throne, both wished to pass themselves off as of illustrious lineage, and therefore beyond the four immediate ancestors they sought a so-called Founding Ancestor to honor.

sentences.zh: 張昭之言，議正而詞偉矣。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhao's words were correct in principle and magnificent in expression.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhao's argument was sound in principle and eloquent in expression.

sentences.zh: 至漢初，則段颙、竇貞固之徒，曲為諂附，乃至上祖高、光，以為六廟雲。）〉

translations.literal: At the beginning of Han, men like Duan Yong and Dou Zheng'gu bent themselves in flattery, going so far as to take Gaozu and Guangwu as ancestors and call it six temples.)〉
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Later Han, men like Duan Yong and Dou Zheng'gu bent themselves in flattery, going so far as to take Gaozu and Guangwu as ancestors and establish six temples.)〉

sentences.zh: 周廣順元年正月，中書門下奏：「太常禮院議，合立太廟室數。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Guangshun of Zhou, the Secretariat memorialized: "The Directorate of Rites has deliberated that the number of chambers in the Grand Temple should be established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Guangshun (951), the Secretariat memorialized: "The Directorate of Rites has deliberated on the number of chambers to be established in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 若守文繼體，則魏、晉有七廟之文；

translations.literal: If one inherits and continues an existing order, Wei and Jin have texts on seven temples;
translations.idiomatic: If one inherits and continues an existing order, Wei and Jin provide precedent for seven temples;

sentences.zh: 若創業開基，則隋、唐有四廟之議。

translations.literal: if one founds a state and lays the foundation, Sui and Tang have deliberations on four temples.
translations.idiomatic: if one founds a state and lays its foundations, Sui and Tang provide precedent for four temples.

sentences.zh: 聖朝請依近禮，追謚四廟。

translations.literal: The sacred court requests following recent rites and posthumously ennobling four temples.
translations.idiomatic: The sacred court requests following recent practice and posthumously ennobling four temples.

sentences.zh: 伏恐所議未同，請下百官集議。

translations.literal: We humbly fear the deliberations may not be unanimous and request that all officials be convened for collective deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: We fear the deliberations may not be unanimous and request that all officials be convened for collective deliberation.

sentences.zh: 」太子太傅和凝等議：「請據禮官議，立四親廟。

translations.literal: " Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent He Ning and others deliberated: "We request that in accordance with the ritual officers' deliberation, four temples of near ancestors be established.
translations.idiomatic: " Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent He Ning and others submitted: "We request that in accordance with the ritual officers' deliberation, four temples of immediate ancestors be established.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

translations.literal: Editorial bracket opens.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial bracket opens.

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：和凝議曰：「恭以肇啟洪圖，惟新黃屋。

translations.literal: (Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties: He Ning deliberated, saying: "We respectfully consider that in inaugurating the great design and renewing the imperial residence,
translations.idiomatic: (Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties: He Ning submitted: "We respectfully consider that in inaugurating the great enterprise and renewing the imperial throne,

sentences.zh: 左宗廟而右社稷，率由舊章；

translations.literal: the ancestral temples are placed to the left and the altars of soil and grain to the right—all following the old regulations;
translations.idiomatic: the ancestral temples are placed to the left and the altars of soil and grain to the right—all following established regulations;

sentences.zh: 崇祖禰而辨尊卑，載於前史。

translations.literal: honoring ancestors and grandfathers while distinguishing high and low—is recorded in former histories.
translations.idiomatic: honoring ancestors and grandfathers while distinguishing rank and precedence—is recorded in former histories.

sentences.zh: 雖質文互變，義趣各殊，或觀損益之規，或系興隆之始。

translations.literal: Although substance and ornament change reciprocally and meanings and aims differ, sometimes one observes rules of increase and decrease, sometimes one is bound to the beginning of rise and prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: Although substance and ornament change over time and meanings differ, sometimes one observes rules of increase and decrease, sometimes one is bound to the origins of a dynasty's rise.

sentences.zh: 陛下體元立極，本義祖仁，開變家成國之基，遵奉先思孝之道，合據禮官議，立四親廟，以葉前文。

translations.literal: Your Majesty embodies the origin and establishes the pole, taking righteousness and ancestral benevolence as the root, opening the foundation of transforming the family into a state and following the way of filial devotion to forebears—we should follow the ritual officers' deliberation and establish four temples of near ancestors to accord with earlier texts.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty embodies the cosmic origin and establishes the supreme pole, taking righteousness and ancestral benevolence as foundation, opening the basis of transforming the family into a state and following the path of filial devotion to forebears. We should follow the ritual officers' deliberation and establish four temples of immediate ancestors to accord with earlier precedent.

translations.literal: " Approved.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.)〉

sentences.zh: 其年四月，中書門下奏：「太常禮院申，七月一日，皇帝御崇元殿，命使奏冊四廟。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of that year, the Secretariat memorialized: "The Directorate of Rites reports that on the first day of the seventh month, the emperor will attend the Chongyuan Hall and order envoys to present the registers to the four temples.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of that year, the Secretariat memorialized: "The Directorate of Rites reports that on the first day of the seventh month, the emperor will attend the Chongyuan Hall and order envoys to present the registers to the four temples.

sentences.zh: 準舊儀，服兗冕即座，太尉引冊案入，皇帝降座，引立於御座前南向，中書令奉冊案進，皇帝搢珪捧授，冊使跪受，轉授舁冊官，其進寶授寶儀如冊案。

translations.literal: According to the old rites, wearing the nine-tasseled cap and descending to the seat, the Grand Marshal leads the register case in; the emperor descends from the seat and stands south-facing before the imperial seat; the Secretariat Director presents the register case; the emperor inserts the scepter and holds it forth in presentation; the register envoy kneels to receive it and transfers it to the bearer of the register; the presentation of the seal and conferral of the seal follow the register case in ritual.
translations.idiomatic: According to the old rites, wearing the nine-tasseled cap and taking the seat, the Grand Marshal leads the register case in; the emperor descends and stands facing south before the imperial seat; the Secretariat Director presents the register case; the emperor inserts the scepter and holds it forth; the register envoy kneels to receive it and transfers it to the bearer of the register; the presentation of the seal follows the same ritual as the register case.

sentences.zh: 臣等參詳，至時請皇帝降階授冊。

translations.literal: We your subjects, in comparative examination, request that at the time the emperor descend the steps to confer the register.
translations.idiomatic: We your subjects request that at the appointed time the emperor descend the steps to confer the register in person.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 三年九月，將有事於南郊，議於東京別建太廟。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year, when there was to be a suburban sacrifice at the southern altar, it was deliberated to separately construct a Grand Temple in the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year, when a suburban sacrifice at the southern altar was planned, deliberation turned to constructing a separate Grand Temple in the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 時太常禮院言：「準洛京廟室一十五間，分為四室，東西各有夾室，四神門，每方屋一間，各三門，戟二十四，別有齋宮神廚屋宇。

translations.literal: At that time the Directorate of Rites said: "According to the Luoyang temple chambers, fifteen bays divided into four chambers, with side chambers to east and west, four spirit gates, one bay per direction with three gates each, twenty-four halberds, and separately a fasting palace, spirit kitchen, and other buildings.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Directorate of Rites reported: "The Luoyang temple has fifteen bays divided into four chambers, with side chambers to east and west, four spirit gates, one bay per direction with three gates each, twenty-four halberds, and separately a fasting palace, spirit kitchen, and other buildings.

sentences.zh: 準禮，左宗廟，右社稷，在國城內，請下所司修奉。

translations.literal: According to the rites, the ancestral temples are to the left and the altars of soil and grain to the right, within the capital walls—we request the responsible offices to construct and maintain them.
translations.idiomatic: According to the rites, the ancestral temples are to the left and the altars of soil and grain to the right, within the capital walls. We request the responsible offices to construct and maintain them.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 其月，太常禮院奏：「迎太廟社稷神主到京，其日未審皇帝親出郊外迎奉否。

translations.literal: That month the Directorate of Rites memorialized: "When the spirit tablets of the Grand Temple and the altars of soil and grain are welcomed to the capital, it is not yet clear whether the emperor will personally go beyond the suburbs to welcome them.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Directorate of Rites memorialized: "When the spirit tablets of the Grand Temple and the altars of soil and grain are welcomed to the capital, it is not yet determined whether the emperor will personally go beyond the suburbs to welcome them.

sentences.zh: 檢討故事，元無禮例，伏請召三省官集議。

translations.literal: Examining precedents, originally there was no ritual example—we humbly request summoning the officials of the Three Departments for collective deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Examining precedents, there was originally no ritual example. We respectfully request summoning the officials of the Three Departments for collective deliberation.

sentences.zh: 」敕：「宜令尚書省四品以上、中書門下五品已上同參議。

translations.literal: Edict: "The Department of State Affairs, from fourth rank and above, together with the Secretariat and Chancellery from fifth rank and above, shall jointly deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: "Officials of the Department of State Affairs from the fourth rank and above, together with the Secretariat and Chancellery from the fifth rank and above, shall jointly deliberate."

sentences.zh: 」司徒竇貞固、司空蘇禹珪等議：「按吳主孫休即位，迎祖父神主於吳郡，人祔太廟，前一日出城野次，明日常服奉迎，此其例也。

translations.literal: " Minister of Education Dou Zheng'gu, Minister of Works Su Yugui, and others deliberated: "According to the precedent when Sun Xiu of Wu took the throne, he welcomed his grandfather's spirit tablet from Wu commandery and enshrined it in the Grand Temple; the day before he went beyond the city to camp in the field, and the next day in regular dress welcomed it—this is the example.
translations.idiomatic: " Minister of Education Dou Zheng'gu, Minister of Works Su Yugui, and others submitted: "According to the precedent when Sun Xiu of Wu took the throne, he welcomed his grandfather's spirit tablet from Wu commandery for enshrinement in the Grand Temple; the day before he went beyond the city to camp in the field, and the next day in regular dress welcomed it—this is the applicable example.

sentences.zh: 」遂署狀言車駕出城奉迎為是，請下禮儀使草定儀註。

translations.literal: " They then signed a report stating that the imperial carriage going beyond the city to welcome was correct, and requested the Commissioner of Ritual to draft the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: They then signed a report stating that the imperial carriage going beyond the city to welcome the tablets was correct, and requested the Commissioner of Ritual to draft the ceremonial regulations.

sentences.zh: 至十月，禮儀使奏：「太祖神主將至，前一日儀仗出城掌次，於西禦莊東北設神主行廟幄幕，面南。

translations.literal: By the tenth month the Commissioner of Ritual memorialized: "When the Taizu spirit tablet is about to arrive, on the preceding day the guard of honor goes beyond the city to set up the encampment; northeast of the Western Imperial Estate a traveling temple canopy for the spirit tablet is set up, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: By the tenth month the Commissioner of Ritual memorialized: "When the Taizu spirit tablet is about to arrive, on the preceding day the guard of honor goes beyond the city to set up the encampment; northeast of the Western Imperial Estate a traveling temple canopy for the spirit tablet is erected, facing south.

sentences.zh: 其日放朝，群臣早出西門，皇帝常服出城詣行宮，群臣起居畢，就次。

translations.literal: On that day court is dismissed; the hundred officials go out early through the western gate; the emperor in regular dress goes beyond the city to the traveling palace; when the hundred officials have finished their salutations, they take their places.
translations.idiomatic: On that day court is dismissed; the hundred officials go out early through the western gate; the emperor in regular dress goes beyond the city to the traveling palace; when the hundred officials have finished their salutations, they take their places.

sentences.zh: 神主將至，群臣班定，皇帝立於班前。

translations.literal: When the spirit tablet is about to arrive, the hundred officials form their ranks; the emperor stands before the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirit tablet is about to arrive, the hundred officials form their ranks; the emperor stands before them.

sentences.zh: 神主至，太常卿請皇帝再拜，群臣俱拜。

translations.literal: When the spirit tablet arrives, the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requests the emperor to bow twice; the hundred officials all bow.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirit tablet arrives, the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requests the emperor to bow twice; all the hundred officials bow.

sentences.zh: 神主就行廟幄幕座，設常饌，群臣班於神幄前。

translations.literal: The spirit tablet is placed on the seat in the traveling temple canopy; regular offerings are set out; the hundred officials rank before the spirit canopy.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit tablet is placed on the seat in the traveling temple canopy; regular offerings are set out; the hundred officials rank before the spirit canopy.

sentences.zh: 侍中就次，請皇帝謁神主。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant takes his place and requests the emperor to approach the spirit tablet.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant takes his place and requests the emperor to approach the spirit tablet.

sentences.zh: 既至，群臣再拜，皇帝進酒畢再拜，群臣俱拜。

translations.literal: When he arrives, the hundred officials bow again; when the emperor has finished presenting wine he bows again; the hundred officials all bow.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrives, the hundred officials bow again; when the emperor has finished presenting wine he bows again; all the hundred officials bow.

sentences.zh: 皇帝還幄，群臣先赴太廟門外立班，俟皇帝至起居。

translations.literal: The emperor returns to the canopy; the hundred officials first go to stand in ranks outside the Grand Temple gate, awaiting the emperor's arrival for salutation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returns to the canopy; the hundred officials first go to stand in ranks outside the Grand Temple gate, awaiting the emperor's arrival for salutation.

sentences.zh: 俟神主至，群臣班於廟門外，皇帝立於班前，太常卿請皇帝再拜，群臣俱拜。

translations.literal: When the spirit tablet arrives, the hundred officials rank outside the temple gate; the emperor stands before the ranks; the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requests the emperor to bow twice; the hundred officials all bow.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirit tablet arrives, the hundred officials rank outside the temple gate; the emperor stands before them; the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requests the emperor to bow twice; all bow.

sentences.zh: 皇帝還幄，群臣就次，宮闈令安神主於本室訖，群臣班於廟庭。

translations.literal: The emperor returns to the canopy; the hundred officials take their places; the Director of Palace Affairs settles the spirit tablet in its chamber; the hundred officials rank in the temple courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returns to the canopy; the hundred officials take their places; the Director of Palace Affairs settles the spirit tablet in its chamber; the hundred officials rank in the temple courtyard.

sentences.zh: 太常卿請皇帝於四室奠饗，逐室皇帝再拜，群臣俱拜。

translations.literal: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requests the emperor to offer at the four chambers; at each chamber the emperor bows twice and the hundred officials all bow.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requests the emperor to offer at the four chambers; at each chamber the emperor bows twice and all the hundred officials bow.

sentences.zh: 四室祔饗畢，皇帝還宮。

translations.literal: When the offerings at the four chambers are completed, the emperor returns to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the offerings at the four chambers are completed, the emperor returns to the palace.

sentences.zh: 前件儀註，望付中書門下宣下。

translations.literal: The foregoing regulations are requested to be promulgated by the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: We request that the foregoing regulations be promulgated by the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 顯德六年七月，詔以大行皇帝山陵有期，神主將祔太廟，其廟殿室宇合添修否？

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year of Xiande, an edict was issued because the late emperor's mountain tomb had a fixed date and the spirit tablet would be enshrined in the Grand Temple, asking whether the temple halls and chambers should be added to or repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year of Xiande (959), an edict was issued because the late emperor's tomb had a fixed date and his spirit tablet would be enshrined in the Grand Temple, inquiring whether the temple halls and chambers should be expanded or repaired.

sentences.zh: 國子司業兼太常博士聶崇義奏議曰：「奉敕，為大行皇帝山陵有期，神主祔廟，恐殿室間數少，合重添修。

translations.literal: Associate Director of the Directorate of Education and Academician of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Nie Chongyi submitted a deliberation, saying: "Receiving the edict, because the late emperor's mountain tomb has a fixed date and the spirit tablet will be enshrined, we fear the number of chambers may be insufficient and that additions and repairs should be made.
translations.idiomatic: Associate Director of the Directorate of Education and Academician of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Nie Chongyi submitted his opinion: "Receiving the edict, because the late emperor's tomb has a fixed date and his spirit tablet will be enshrined, we fear the number of chambers may be insufficient and that additions and repairs may be needed.

sentences.zh: 今詣廟中相度，若是添修廟殿一間至兩間，並須移動諸神門及角樓宮墻仗舍，及堂殿正面檐栿階道，亦須東省牲立班位，直至齋宮，漸近迫窄。

translations.literal: Now inspecting the temple, if one or two chambers of the temple hall are added or repaired, all the spirit gates, corner towers, palace walls, guard houses, and the main hall's front eaves, rafters, and steps would have to be moved, and the eastern side for slaughtering victims and standing in ranks, extending to the fasting palace, would gradually become cramped.
translations.idiomatic: On inspecting the temple, if one or two chambers of the temple hall are added or repaired, all the spirit gates, corner towers, palace walls, guard houses, and the main hall's front eaves, rafters, and steps would have to be moved, and the eastern side for slaughtering victims and forming ranks, extending to the fasting palace, would gradually become cramped.

sentences.zh: 今重拆廟殿，續更添修，不唯重勞，兼恐未便。

translations.literal: Now to demolish and rebuild the temple hall and additionally repair it would not only impose heavy labor but also may be inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: To demolish and rebuild the temple hall would not only impose heavy labor but may also prove impractical.

sentences.zh: 竊見廟殿見虛東西二夾室，況未有祧遷之主，欲請不拆廟殿，更添間數，即便將夾室重安排六室位次。

translations.literal: We observe that the temple hall presently has vacant eastern and western side chambers, and since there is as yet no spirit-lord for distancing removal, we request not to demolish the temple hall but to add chambers, immediately rearranging the six chambers' positions in the side chambers.
translations.idiomatic: We observe that the temple hall presently has vacant eastern and western side chambers, and since there is as yet no spirit-lord requiring distancing removal, we request not to demolish the temple hall but to add chambers, immediately rearranging positions for six chambers in the side chambers.

sentences.zh: 所有動移神主，若準舊禮，於殿庭權設行廟幕殿，即恐雨水猶多，難於陳設。

translations.literal: As for moving the spirit tablets, if according to the old rites a traveling temple canopy is provisionally set up in the temple courtyard, we fear that with much rain still falling it would be difficult to set up.
translations.idiomatic: As for moving the spirit tablets, if according to the old rites a traveling temple canopy is provisionally set up in the temple courtyard, we fear that with rain still frequent it would be difficult to arrange.

sentences.zh: 伏請權於太廟齋宮內奉安神主，至修奉畢日，庶為宜稱。

translations.literal: We humbly request provisionally settling the spirit tablets in the fasting palace of the Grand Temple until the day repairs are completed—this would be appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully request provisionally settling the spirit tablets in the Grand Temple's fasting palace until repairs are completed—this would be most appropriate.

sentences.zh: 又，按《禮記》云：廟成則於中屋刲羊以釁之，夾室則用雞。

translations.literal: Moreover, according to the Book of Rites: when the temple is completed, a sheep is slaughtered in the central chamber to smear it with blood; for side chambers a chicken is used.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, according to the Book of Rites: when the temple is completed, a sheep is slaughtered in the central chamber for the smearing rite; for side chambers a chicken is used.

sentences.zh: 又，《大戴禮》及《通典》亦有夾室，察文觀義，乃是備廟之制。

translations.literal: Moreover, the Elder Dai's Rites and the Tongdian also have side chambers; examining the texts and observing the meaning, these are institutions for completing the temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Elder Dai's Rites and the Tongdian also describe side chambers; examining the texts and observing their meaning, these are institutions for completing the temple complex.

sentences.zh: 況新主祔廟，諸經有遷易之文，考古沿今，庶合通禮。

translations.literal: Moreover, when a new spirit-lord is enshrined, the classics have texts on moving and changing; examining antiquity and following the present, this should accord with comprehensive rites.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when a new spirit-lord is enshrined, the classics provide authority for relocation; examining antiquity and following present practice, this should accord with comprehensive ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 伏請遞遷諸室奉安大行皇帝神主，以符禮意。

translations.literal: We humbly request sequentially moving the chambers to settle the late emperor's spirit tablet, to accord with ritual meaning.
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully request sequentially moving the chambers to settle the late emperor's spirit tablet, in accordance with ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 」敕依典禮。

translations.literal: Edict: Follow the canonical rites.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: Follow the canonical rites.
